findings.reason: MapLibre GL 6 exposes named ESM exports; default import was unavailable.
findings.resolution: Use namespace import; no data or criteria changed.

findings.reason: MapLibre GL 6 ESM bundle expects an explicit external worker module; it was absent from the initial static output. No object data was requested.
findings.resolution: Bundle the pinned map worker and set its URL explicitly; retain browser-r1 evidence.

findings.reason: DuckDB attempted to fetch its Parquet extension from a remote service; the browser test correctly blocked external requests. A direct default-client download also returned 403.
findings.resolution: Pin released DuckDB-Wasm 1.32.0 and its engine v1.4.3 extension, acquired from the official endpoint with the explicit application User-Agent; bundle the SHA-256-pinned 3,045,039-byte extension locally and explicitly load it from the UI origin.

findings.reason: Reader file registry still forced full HTTP reads while the viewer prohibited them. Changing the alias and direct-I/O flag alone did not fix that configuration.
findings.resolution: Explicitly set filesystem.forceFullHTTPReads=false and allowFullHTTPReads=false, with direct URL registration. Assert the registry is not in forced-full mode before querying. HydroLAKES then rendered 606 features with 5,020,112 bytes of partial data reads.

review_fixes: Guard stale attribute-query errors by selection generation.
Increase Resource Timing buffers and clear full buffers in both window and Parquet worker.
Validate browser-observed Content-Range start/end/total and Content-Length against each requested range.
